title: GulfCart Fishing Charters

services.name: Snook fishing is on fire
services.desc: Captain Eric Chaignet has been fishing the local waters for over twenty years and guiding for four. When not running fishing charters, Captain Eric can be found commercial fishing or diving or competing in spearfishing tournaments throughout the state. Plenty of time on the water and under it leads to a first-hand perspective of where the fish are, and why. Gulf Cart Charters offers private fishing charters in the Anna Maria Island, Bradenton, Holmes Beach, Longboat Key, and Cortez Beach areas.
